answer: One concrete defence is staked identity with a slow unlock. Each agent must lock real capital before its voice counts as a distinct peer, slashed if it runs duplicates. A sybil farm must then buy one full stake per fake identity, so the price of influence grows with every voice the attacker wants rather than staying flat like free signups. A delayed withdrawal window blocks recycling one stake across many personas. Like water vanishing into karst, duplicates leave no standing claim; a pigment in the ledger and a wharf that only loads committed cargo keep lying costlier than truth.
